add('Q01','Shuffle and lay out players + 1 Factory cards face-down; return the rest unseen. Put one encounter token on each of 11 marked territories and randomly select one structure bonus tile face-up below the Popularity Track. The lowest-numbered Player Mat starts.','Setup: “number of players + 1”; “11 marked territories”; “lowest-numbered Player Mat starts.”')
add('Q02','Each player’s character starts at home; two workers on the two land-adjoined territories adjoining home; four mechs on faction abilities; six stars by faction emblem; six technology cubes in black-square green boxes; four structures in matching boxes; four recruits in bottom circular spaces; six remaining workers on Produce red rectangles; action token beside Player Mat. Faction Mat sets starting power and combat-card draw; Player Mat sets starting popularity, coins, and two objective cards.','Setup piece table and step 3.')
add('Q03','You must move the token to a different section, but may take neither action, either, or both. Rusviet may repeat a section (including Factory); others cannot repeat last turn’s section. Top must precede bottom; cannot take bottom first or return to top. Top-row gains may pay bottom-row costs. Pay all exposed red-box costs before choosing any amount of exposed green benefits; use the mat for variable costs/benefits.','Turn Structure: “must move”; “first pay the full cost”; “top-row gains to pay the bottom-row cost.”')
add('Q04','An enemy worker alone on your structure’s territory controls the territory and its resources. Enemy units do not gain your structure’s abilities; you retain those abilities, except an uncontrolled Mill cannot produce. Pay for actions with resources from any territories you currently control, even when acting elsewhere.','Control, resources and home bases.')
add('Q05','A normal Move selects up to two different units and moves each one adjacent territory; the same unit cannot be selected twice. A transported worker’s carriage does not count as its own movement, so it may subsequently move itself. All unit types can carry any number of resources; only mechs may carry your workers, and never your character.','Top-row Move: “two different units”; “Being carried does not count”; “Only mechs may also carry”.')
add('Q06','A character or mech entering enemy-workers-only territory stops and cannot move again that turn; those workers immediately retreat home and leave resources. You lose one popularity per worker, down to zero; zero popularity or insufficient popularity does not stop retreat. Your workers cannot enter independently while enemy workers control it.','Enemy workers only.')
add('Q07','After all units finish moving, resolve all combats before the bottom-row action; the attacker chooses order if there are multiple combats. Workers cannot independently move into or out of territory controlled by enemy characters/mechs.','Enemy character/mechs; Combat.')
add('Q08','Bolster costs $1 and gives two power or one combat card. If the combat deck is empty, shuffle discards to form a new deck; if both deck and discard are empty, draw none. Trade costs $1 and gives any two resources (same or different) or one popularity. Put traded resources on a controlled territory containing at least one worker; if all workers are home, you cannot Trade for resources.','Bolster; Trade.')
add('Q09','Pay all exposed Produce costs (power, popularity and/or coins) in full before production. Then choose up to two different controlled territories, with each worker there optionally producing one matching terrain token onto that territory. New workers come from Player Mat left to right and go into the producing village. Production, including new workers, may be declined partly or wholly. Newly exposed costs affect future Produce actions, not the cost already paid.','Produce steps 1–3.')
add('Q10','Upgrade costs the exposed number of oil tokens; move a cube from a green box to an empty bracketed red box to improve a top benefit and reduce a bottom cost (solid-black-bordered red boxes are ineligible). Deploy costs exposed metal; place a mech from the Faction Mat on a controlled territory containing your worker, never a lake; its uncovered ability applies to your character and all mechs, not workers. Even when all such pieces/goals are completed, you may still pay a bottom action to gain its coins and applicable ongoing recruit bonuses.','Bottom-row actions: Upgrade, Deploy; completed-action paragraph.')
add('Q11','Build a structure on a controlled territory with your worker; only one structure total per territory, even including opponents’ structures; Factory is allowed, lakes/home bases forbidden. Structures cannot move or be destroyed. A Mill’s bonus production applies only while you control its territory; a Mine remains your personal tunnel for movement even when enemy-controlled. Enemy occupants do not gain building abilities; you retain them, except an uncontrolled Mill cannot produce.','Build; Control, resources and home bases.')
add('Q12','Enlist: take a recruit from any bottom-row section, put it permanently on any open one-time bonus space on your Faction Mat, immediately gaining two power, two coins, two popularity, or two combat cards. Ongoing bonus is the circle uncovered at its source section: Upgrade +1 power, Deploy +1 coin, Build +1 popularity, Enlist +1 combat card. Resolve the active player, then left neighbor, then right neighbor; if sixth star ends play, stop. In two-player play opponent triggers once, not twice.','Enlist; Ongoing recruits.')
add('Q13','Both combatants simultaneously and secretly choose dial power 0 through min(7,current power), and may add up to one card per participating character/mech; Rusviet People’s Army adds one card total if any workers present. If both have combat mech abilities, attacker resolves theirs first. Add dial and card values; attacker wins ties. Each pays selected dial power from track; played cards are discarded face-up, without extra track-power payment.','Combat steps 1–4; faction abilities.')
add('Q14','After combat, winner controls territory/resources. Non-Saxony winner places a combat star if it has zero or one combat stars; with two it places none; Saxony places a star after each victory while tokens remain. All losing characters, mechs, and workers retreat home (Nordic Seaworthy eligible units/workers may instead retreat to adjacent lakes); resources remain. Winning attacker loses one popularity per enemy worker forced to retreat (Camaraderie exception); winning defender loses none. Loser draws one combat card if it revealed any power by dial or cards; zero-total loser gets none.','Combat step 5–6.')
add('Q15','Only the character triggers an encounter. After whole Move action and all combats, resolve it if character remains; contested-entry loser retreats and token remains. Drawn card gains go to the encounter territory. Pay its printed cost and may take as little benefit as desired, but pay no normal action cost and get no mat benefits or ongoing recruit bonuses.','Encounters.')
add('Q16','Every player’s character on its first finish of a Move action at Factory (after winning any combat) looks at available cards, chooses one, and returns rest; each player gets one permanent card and later visits cannot exchange it. Use as fifth section with optional top then bottom and ordinary repeat restriction/Rusviet exception. Factory actions give no corresponding Player Mat coins, structure or ongoing recruit bonuses. Factory bottom Move moves one unit up to two territories, or three for Speed character/mech.','Factory.')
add('Q17','Only on your own turn, before or after completing a top or bottom action, reveal a completed objective; requirements must all be met then. Place objective star and put both objective cards on bottom of deck. Normally only one objective star; Saxony retains the other card and can score both.','Objectives and agreements.')
add('Q18','Stars are earned for six upgrades, four mechs, four structures, four recruits, all eight workers on board, one revealed completed objective, combat victory (up to two stars), 18 popularity, or 16 power. Each goal once except two combat stars and Saxony’s exception; another player’s star does not block it. Stars cannot be lost. Sixth star ends play immediately.','Stars and immediate end.')
add('Q19','When a bottom action earns sixth star, first collect primary benefit, coins, and your ongoing recruit benefit, then place star. For neighbor power/popularity recruit stars: finish action, resolve active player then left then right and check sixth star at each step; stop later bonuses/stars once game ends. Pending intermingled battles are not resolved; undo that movement, returning initiating units.','Stars and immediate end.')
add('Q20','At popularity 10, rate is $4 per star, $3 per territory count, and $2 per complete resource pair. Five stars = $20; four ordinary territories plus Factory count as 7 = $21; 13 resources make 6 pairs = $12. Add held coins and eligible structure tile bonus; structures score tile even if enemy controls their territories. Tiebreakers: workers+mechs+structures, power, popularity, resources controlled, territories controlled, stars placed.','Final fortune tables and tiebreakers.')
add('Q21','Home base is not a territory. Normally you cannot move back into any home base (setup, forced retreat, and Crimea Wayfare exceptions). Bases without matching core factions are inactive expansion placeholders.','Control, resources and home bases.')
add('Q22','Mountain→metal; tundra→oil; farm→food; forest→wood; village→worker; lake and Factory produce nothing. Workers are not resources. Resource tokens have no supply limit; use multipliers if needed.','Produce terrain table; resources section.')
add('Q23','All units can pick up/carry/drop resources mid-movement; mechs can also carry workers but never characters. Speed adds one territory to each selected character/mech, not workers; tunnel jump costs one step and extra step may be before or after. Mechs may pick up/drop resources/workers mid-move. Enemy/encounter stops override Speed.','Move; Speed.')
add('Q24','Yes, any unit may enter a territory with only an enemy structure, taking control without combat. Printed tunnel territories are adjacent for movement by any unit.','Move: Enemy structure only; printed tunnels.')
add('Q25','You may not pay a partial cost. If unable to afford any action, take a dead turn: move token to a different section and take neither action.','Turn Structure.')
add('Q26','Armory grants +1 power with Trade; Monument grants +1 popularity with Bolster. Benefits are ongoing matching top actions, and you keep them even without control, except Mill production; enemy units do not gain structure abilities.','Bolster; Trade; Build; Control.')
add('Q27','Riverwalk is a separately unlocked mech ability for each faction, letting character and all mechs cross rivers (not workers): Nordic/Saxony to forests and mountains; Rusviet to farms and villages; Crimea to farms and tundra; Polania to villages and mountains. Nordic Swim is its starting ability for workers only to cross rivers to land terrain, not lakes; it does not give Nordic mechs lake movement.','Faction and unlocked mech abilities; Riverwalk table.')
add('Q28','Saxony Underpass makes controlled mountains and all tunnels (including own Mine) adjacent for character/mech Move actions. Rusviet Township makes controlled villages and Factory adjacent for character/mech Move actions.','Other unlocked mech abilities.')
add('Q29','Saxony Disarm: before combat on a tunnel or own Mine, opponent loses two power on track, once per combat, not per unit. Nordic Artillery: before combat, may pay one power to reduce opponent power by two, once per combat, not per unit.','Other unlocked mech abilities.')
add('Q30','With People’s Army, play one additional combat card total if at least one worker is present; two mechs and three workers permit three cards total. Workers alone never fight.','Rusviet Township; Combat.')
add('Q31','Crimea Wayfare lets character/mechs move from territory or home base to own or any inactive faction home base regardless of distance, including inactive expansion bases. They cannot enter an active opponent home base.','Crimea Wayfare.')
add('Q32','Crimea Scout steals one random opponent combat card into your hand before combat, once per combat, not per unit. Coercion lets you once per turn spend one combat card as any one resource regardless of card value.','Crimea abilities.')
add('Q33','Nordic Seaworthy lets character/mechs move to/from lakes and retreat to an adjacent lake instead of home; mechs may carry workers with them. Polania Submerge lets character/mechs move to/from lakes and from any lake to any other lake; it provides no adjacent-lake retreat exception. When leaving a lake, workers require a mech; carried workers and resources cannot be left behind.','Nordic Seaworthy; Polania Submerge.')
add('Q34','Polania Camaraderie prevents popularity loss for opposing workers forced to retreat after you win combat as aggressor on your turn. It does not cover driving out undefended workers without combat.','Polania Camaraderie.')
add('Q35','Meander allows up to two different options on one encounter card, in either order; first gain may pay second cost. Must pay chosen printed cost and may take as little benefit as desired.','Polania Meander; Encounters.')
add('Q36','On Factory bottom Move, character entering encounter territory stops and cannot move again that turn. Resolve after whole Move action and all combats, if character remains; it does not occur before all combats finish.','Encounters; Factory.')
add('Q37','Coins are not hidden, but you need not reveal their total value when asked. Combat card hand count public, contents secret until revealed; during combat may conceal whether you committed any cards until reveal. Objectives secret until revealing completed objective.','Public and hidden information.')
add('Q38','Coins are the only tangible items exchangeable; agreements are informal and unenforceable. A payment/bribe cannot cancel combat once initiated by moving units onto opposing units; combat resolves after Move.','Objectives and agreements.')
add('Q39','Popularity 0–6: $3/star, $2/territory, $1/pair resources; 7–12: $4/$3/$2; 13–18: $5/$4/$3. Controlled lakes count; home bases do not. Factory counts as three territories. Score only complete resource pairs, odd single resource ignored.','Final fortune.')
add('Q40','Adjacency bonus counts unique printed tunnels (not Mines), unique lakes, or unique printed encounter locations even if token removed. Each feature counts once across all structures; rivers do not break adjacency. Payouts for tunnels: 1 $2, 2–3 $4, 4–5 $6, 6 $9; lakes/encounters: 1 $2, 2–3 $4, 4–5 $6, 6–7 $9.','Structure bonus eligibility table.')
add('Q41','Structures on tunnels count printed tunnels, not Mines: 1 $2, 2 $4, 3–4 $6. Structures in a row count only longest continuous straight line; rivers do not break line; payout 1 $2, 2 $4, 3 $6, 4 $9. Farms/tundras count combined qualifying structures; same 1 $2, 2 $4, 3 $6, 4 $9.','Structure bonus eligibility table.')
add('Q42','Yes. Winning attacker loses one popularity per enemy worker forced to retreat, including workers carried by a defeated mech on a lake.','Combat step 6.')
add('Q43','A popularity star is permanent, but does not protect current popularity or scoring tier: current popularity determines final scoring. Another player’s star never blocks your goal.','Stars and immediate end.')
add('Q44','Randomly deal one Faction Mat and one Player Mat to each player. Seat factions in order Nordic, Rusviet, Crimea, Saxony, Polania clockwise, omitting inactive factions. This determines immediate left/right neighbors whose bottom actions trigger ongoing recruit bonuses.','Setup steps 2 and 5; Ongoing recruits.')
add('Q45','A river is a border between two land territories; a lake occupies an entire hex and extends to every adjacent shoreline. A unit with lake movement can enter from any surrounding land territory adjoining those shores.','Move movement rules.')
add('Q46','No. Show the drawn encounter card to all players, show its artwork, and read the capitalized thematic text aloud; need not read every option aloud.','Encounters.')
add('Q47','No limit applies to friendly units or resource tokens on a territory.','Control, resources and home bases.')
add('Q48','Next clockwise player may begin their turn after current player starts a noninteractive bottom-row action, while current player decides which upgrade, mech, structure, or recruit to gain.','Turn Structure.')
add('Q49','No. Top and bottom actions are each limited to once within a turn, including Rusviet; Rusviet repetition only waives previous-turn section restriction.','Turn Structure.')
add('Q50','Normal unupgraded Move may be used to gain $1 instead of moving units.','Move OR coins.')
add('Q51','No. Workers never return to Player Mat; a retreated worker goes to home base, not Player Mat.','Produce; Enemy workers only.')
add('Q52','Yes. You may attack with zero power and zero popularity.','Combat.')
add('Q53','Yes. A non-Saxony player with two combat stars places no further combat star but may still fight after reaching combat-star limit.','Combat step 5.')
add('Q54','No. Without Meander, you must choose one affordable option; cannot decline all or choose unaffordable coin/popularity option. You may take as little of chosen option’s benefit as desired.','Encounters.')
add('Q55','No turn-order selection is specified: combatants simultaneously and secretly choose dials/cards; reveal simultaneously.','Combat steps 1–3.')
add('Q56','Announce the bottom-row action so neighbors can check recruit bonuses.','Bottom-row actions.')
add('Q57','No. Place a star as soon as goal achieved; sixth star immediately ends game. An objective can be held and reveal delayed, but reveal only on own turn before/after a top/bottom action and requirements must be met at reveal.','Stars and immediate end; Objectives and agreements.')
add('Q58','No. Units cannot normally cross rivers or enter lakes; abilities provide exceptions.','Move movement rules.')
add('Q59','No. Enlisted recruit placed on Faction Mat bonus space cannot later move.','Enlist.')
add('Q60','No. Only a character triggers an encounter; its entry stops it, then encounter resolves after Move and all combats if it remains.','Encounters.')
add('Q61','Controlled Mill provides one bonus production territory in addition to normal allowance: up to 3 rather than 2, or 4 if upgraded allowance is 3. Mill counts as one producing worker; actual workers there also produce normally; Mill can produce on its terrain without an actual worker. It cannot produce if territory uncontrolled.','Produce; Build; control.')
add('Q62','Control comes from your unit there, or your structure there with no enemy unit. Resources alone do not establish/control a territory; after last unit leaves and with no structure, resources do not preserve control.','Control, resources and home bases.')
add('Q63','Build costs wood; Enlist costs food.','Player Reference: Bottom resources.')
